content: ItemSummary (search response) fields include itemId, title, price{value,currency}, image, itemLocation, and shippingOptions (typed as ShippingOptionSummary -- a lighter search-time variant distinct from the full ShippingOption returned by getItem), with shippingOptions[].shippingCost.value accessible directly from item_summary/search results without a follow-up getItem call. This matches the pattern already implemented in scripts/ebay_client.py from Phase 1 (unverified live -- credentials lost, Plan 01-04 incomplete).
